name: memory
description: reddb.io memory plugin - persistent, queryable memory for code agents that lives on top of dev. Supports markdown notes, RedDB graph memory, graph ingest/recall/export, optional lifecycle hooks, MCP, and Skill telemetry for self-improvement.

interface.longDescription: RedSkills Memory gives code agents a persistent, queryable memory that survives /clear and crosses sessions. It supports markdown-only notes and a RedDB-backed graph mode with repo ingest, hybrid graph recall, graph export, optional lifecycle hooks, MCP access, and Skill telemetry used by report-only curator diagnostics. Builds on the dev plugin processes.
defaultPrompt: Run $init to set up markdown-only or graph memory.
Capture a decision with $store, or extract durable facts with $extract.
Look up what we know with $recall, then inspect self-improvement telemetry with $skills-status.
